keywords.name: Unique
keywords.description: A deck may only contain one version of this card

keywords.name: Fast Play
keywords.description: When a card is bought from the shop, you may pay 1 {omen} if you do play this card (Not paying its cost).

keywords.name: Guidance
keywords.description: If the arrow is in the second half trigger the following effect

keywords.name: Guidance
keywords.description: If the arrow is in the first half trigger the following effect

keywords.name: Carve
keywords.description: You can pay the omen cost (min 1) to remove the dormant ability of this card. A carved Rune stays in play across rounds until it is broken or discarded. You may only have as many Runes carved as your limit allows.

keywords.name: Break
keywords.description: At any time, discard one of your carved Runes to resolve its Break effect, if that effect would do something. Your first Break is free, the next adds 1 {omen}, then 2, and so on. The count resets at the start of the player phase. A Rune you are made to discard cannot be broken.

keywords.name: Shrouded
keywords.description: Count this entity card's omen cost towards the reveal, then lay it face down in the storyline. Its arrow and effect stay hidden until it resolves or is lit.

keywords.name: Fire
keywords.description:
Whilst a district in a town is on fire, it cannot be used. 
Removing from a district costs 1 gold and adds 2 omen.

keywords.name: retire
keywords.description: As an action you may put this card from play and shuffle it into the shop. If you do draw a card.

keywords.name: Dormant
keywords.description: This card doesn't count as being in play for the player. Its rule text is blank. (This card still count towards anything the storyline is saying)
keywords.reminder: This card doesn't count as being in play for the player

keywords.name: Clouded Mind
keywords.description:
Players cannot prevent this effect. The players cannot talk about this event together.
Only the first player can decide what to do.

keywords.name: Everlasting
keywords.description: This card cannot be removed or discarded in anyway.
